visualCharacteristics: Grid of brand logo tiles; each tile is an image link with a visually hidden or small brand name.
contentPattern: One row per brand: logo image | link paragraph (link text = brand name for screen readers, href = tile link). Section heading and trailing CTA are default content.
usage: Brand logo showcase linking to each brand page.
reuseGuidance: Reuse for any logo grid where each logo links out (brands, partners).
